comment: Protection-system signatures for nar-triage, extracted from code into this versioned data artifact (Evolution Phase 5). Detection and reporting ONLY: a hit means protection artifacts or protection code ship inside the package; it says nothing about whether a check passed at runtime, and NAR never uses this to bypass anything. A finding is attributed to a named product only when a marker is dedicated to that product (a protector runtime library, its stub application class, or its SDK package); generic names that collide with ordinary libraries are never used as markers (no bare libshell.so, no bare frida). Protection kinds with no reliable static marker (DexGuard string encryption, OLLVM control-flow flattening, in-code signature checks, RASP runtimes renamed per build) are deliberately absent: triage stays silent there and the triage guide says so. DEX patterns are ASCII class/package strings from the shipped runtimes; the Widevine UUID forms are hex because three of the four are binary. Bump database_version on any signature change.

packers.name: Pairip (Google)
packers.note: VM-based protection. The runtime library name is dedicated, and the runtime classes (application, license check) live under com/pairip/.

packers.name: Tencent Legu
packers.note: Shell libraries are versioned (libshella-2.x.so, libshellx-*.so); the stub application package is com.tencent.StubShell. com.tencent.bugly is a crash reporter, not Legu, and is deliberately absent.

packers.name: Qihoo 360 Jiagu
packers.note: libjiagu*.so (libjiagu.so, libjiagu_art.so, libjiagu_x86.so); the stub application is com.stub.StubApp.

packers.name: Bangcle SecShell
packers.note: Also sold as SecNeo: libsecexe.so / libsecmain.so / libSecShell*.so; runtime classes under com/secshell/SecShell.

packers.name: Alibaba SecurityGuard
packers.note: SecurityGuard / Mobisec: versioned libsgmainso-*.so (the prefix matcher covers libsgmain.so too), libmobisec.so; the SecurityGuard SDK package is com/alibaba/wireless/security (the vendor's ordinary app packages are not markers).

packers.name: NetEase YiDun
packers.note: Wrapper library libnesec.so; wrapper package com/netease/nis/wrapper.

packers.name: iJiami
packers.note: libexec.so / libexecmain.so, an ijiami.dat payload in assets, and the shell application class (shipped under both the plain and the obfuscated s.h.e.l.l package).

packers.name: DexProtector
packers.note: Licel: the runtime library carries the product name (libDexProtector.so, case varies by build).

rasp_dex_markers.name: Root-related markers (su / Magisk / Superuser)
rasp_dex_markers.note: Strings checked by root detectors; the same paths can also be probed by apps that offer root features.

rasp_dex_markers.name: SafetyNet attestation (legacy)
rasp_dex_markers.note: Client-side presence only: the attestation verdict is made by Google's servers, never inside the APK.

widevine.comment: The Widevine MediaDrm scheme UUID edef8ba9-79d6-4ace-a3c8-27dcd51d21ed reaches a DEX as the dashed string, as the raw 16 UUID bytes, or as the two 64-bit halves stored little-endian by compiled new UUID(msb, lsb) code. The finding fires on the string form, the raw bytes, or BOTH halves in the SAME dex; one half alone is not evidence. A bare MediaDrm reference is generic Android API use, never a marker.
